name: Zemanek Marine Services, Inc.
summary: Marine surveying and consulting for cargo, vessels and claims, in the heart of Houston and at the doorway to the Port of Houston.

hero.title: Professional, high-level service
hero.lead: Zemanek Marine Services, Inc. is the company you are looking for to provide professional, high-level service for your marine surveying and consulting needs, backed by forty years of experience in the industry.
hero.imageAlt: A tug working past container cranes at a port terminal at sunset

groups.title: Surveying
groups.summary: We provide a variety of surveys to meet your needs for your next project.
groups.intro: All of our surveys are done with the intention of mitigating losses to the greatest extent. The list below is the work we are called out for, from a draft reading or a hatch cover test to a full investigation of a damaged or short-landed cargo.
groups.imageAlt: Shoreside cranes lifting large cylindrical sections onto a heavy lift vessel

services.title: Bunker
services.text: Fuel on board measured and recorded, at a delivery, either side of a transfer or at a change of charter.

services.title: Condition
services.text: The state of a vessel, a hold or a piece of cargo recorded as it is found, with photographs and notes.

services.title: Damage
services.text: Damage to cargo or to a vessel examined and documented, with the extent set down for the parties involved.

services.title: Discharge
services.text: Cargo attended as it comes off the vessel, with its condition and any damage recorded as it happens.

services.title: Draft
services.text: Draft readings taken before and after working cargo to determine the weight loaded or discharged.

services.title: Fumigation
services.text: The fumigation of a cargo or a hold attended and recorded.

services.title: Hatch Cover
services.text: Hatch covers examined and tested for weathertightness before a cargo is loaded.

services.title: Heavy Lift
services.text: Oversized and heavy pieces surveyed through the lift, the stowage and the securing.

services.title: Inventory
services.text: Cargo counted and recorded piece by piece against the manifest or the packing list.

services.title: Investigation
services.text: What happened to a cargo or a vessel established from the evidence, the records and the people who were there.

services.title: Lashing & Securing
services.text: Lashings, dunnage and securing arrangements examined before the vessel sails.

services.title: Loading
services.text: Cargo attended as it is loaded, with the stowage and the condition it went aboard in recorded.

services.title: Loss Control & Prevention
services.text: Handling, stowage and storage reviewed to find where a cargo is being lost or damaged, and what would stop it.

services.title: Mill Claims
services.text: Steel and mill cargo claims examined against the mill certificates and the shipping records.

services.title: Off-Hire
services.text: The vessel's condition, bunkers and stores recorded at redelivery at the end of a charter.

services.title: On-Hire
services.text: The vessel's condition, bunkers and stores recorded on delivery into a charter.

services.title: Personal Effects
services.text: Household goods and personal shipments examined and listed, before or after the move.

services.title: Project Cargo
services.text: Project shipments followed through loading, stowage, securing and discharge, piece by piece.

services.title: Quality Control
services.text: Cargo checked against the specification and the condition it is required to be in.

services.title: Shortage Investigation
services.text: A short-landed or missing cargo traced back through the tally, the records and the terminal.

groups.title: Consulting
groups.summary: We provide expert consulting services backed by over 40 years of experience.
groups.intro: Beyond the survey itself, we are brought in when a claim has to be made, defended or explained. We have considerable experience in assisting with subrogation efforts, and we have given many depositions as well as testified in federal courts.
groups.imageAlt: A loaded container ship under way at sea, seen from above

services.title: Expert Witness
services.text: Depositions and testimony on cargo and vessel matters, in federal court in the United States and abroad.
points: Testimony in federal court, both in the United States and abroad
An abundance of success for his clients
Considerable experience assisting with subrogation efforts

services.title: Investigation
services.text: The circumstances behind a loss, a claim or an incident worked through from the documents and the evidence.

services.title: Port Captain
services.text: A representative at the berth on your behalf, overseeing the cargo operation from start to finish.

about.title: Forty years on the waterfront.
text: Zemanek Marine Services, Inc. is a marine surveying and consulting firm, providing professional, high-level service for your marine surveying and consulting needs.
ZMS is owned and operated by John P. Zemanek, Jr., who is a graduate of the United States Merchant Marine Academy and has over 40 years experience in the industry.

All of our surveys are done with the intention of mitigating losses to the greatest extent. We have considerable experience in assisting with subrogation efforts. We have given many depositions as well as testified in federal courts.

facts.heading: Our Team
items: John Zemanek, President. He founded Zemanek Marine Services, Inc. in 2001, after 17 years with another marine surveying firm in the Houston area, and began his marine surveying career in 1984 on graduating from the United States Merchant Marine Academy.

Stephanie Zemanek, Office Manager. She joined in 2006 after almost twenty years with Sea-Land Services and then Maersk Sealand, where she held various positions including Administration Manager and Facilities Manager, and is responsible for all administrative and accounting duties.

facts.heading: Areas Of Expertise
items: Steel cargoes, discharge and damage surveys
Investigation surveys, including inventory and loss control and prevention
Work with steel trading companies, container lines, freight forwarders, stevedores, Port Authorities, and domestic and international underwriters

facts.heading: Membership
facts.text: John is a member of the National Association of Marine Surveyors.
